name: get-digital-your-school

scripts.build: npm run prepare:pdf-fonts && turbo run build

scripts.qa:release-migrations: node --test scripts/verify-production-migrations.test.mjs scripts/migration-recovery-0008-policy.test.mjs && node scripts/verify-production-migrations.mjs && npm run qa:migrations
